posts.name: Plurai Simulation
posts.tagline: A simulated world that makes your agent improve on every run
posts.description: Find your agent’s worst bugs before your users do. One command in Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot builds a digital twin of your agent’s world: synthetic personas and documents, plus mocked tools, APIs and databases, in sandboxes that never touch production.

posts.name: YouArt Desktop App
posts.tagline: Codex for creative team
posts.description: Meet YouArt Desktop App: AI creative teammate that lives on your computer. Agent-first video production is here. Pull your local files and context from Slack, Gmail and GitHub onto one canvas, and with computer use it operates After Effects, CapCut and Blender directly. From feature launch videos to viral remakes and clips from your long videos, it takes the whole job end to end. Bring your own API keys, and smart routing sends every shot to the cheapest provider.

posts.name: Omnigraph
posts.tagline: Open source graph database for your AI agents
posts.description: Omnigraph is an open-source object-storage native graph database with branching and typed ontology. It allows AI agents safely collaborate on shared knowledge. Give agents one typed graph with Git-like branching, review, and merge for every write, so changes can be validated before becoming shared context. Run it on your own S3-compatible storage, with semantic, keyword, and hybrid search plus graph traversal in one query. No hosted memory API or proprietary storage required.

posts.name: ⌘+L
posts.tagline: Edit your website like Figma!
posts.description: Command L (⌘+L) is a magical script tag so you can edit your website like a Figma file. In the background, Claude Code, Codex, or Letterpress-1 will automatically turn the change into the perfect pull request.

posts.name: Spacefast by Automattic
posts.tagline: Give your AI agents a place to build, run, and ship
posts.description: Spacefast is a new way to ship websites and apps with the AI you already use. Connect ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Cursor, or your favorite agent, and publish your project with a simple request. Spacefast handles hosting, databases, domains, file uploads, and version history. Share private links, collect feedback directly on your pages, and let your agent make updates. Built by Automattic, the company behind WordPress.com. Free to start, with no extra AI subscription.

posts.name: Adobe AI Assistant
posts.tagline: Create and edit faster with AI across Adobe apps
posts.description: Adobe AI Assistant brings conversational AI into Creative Cloud. Describe what you want to accomplish, and let it handle multi-step creative tasks across Photoshop, Premiere, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, and Firefly.

posts.name: Harness Memory
posts.tagline: Long-term memory for agents, across every harness
posts.description: Harness Memory gives every harness agent its own long-term memory. Pick a memory engine (Mem0, Graphiti, Hindsight, ReMe, or your own) and plug it into different agent harnesses, like Claude Code, Codex and Hermes. Memory can be shared across agent harnesses, with fine-grained access control. Open source in Community Edition and available on HarnessRouter Cloud.

posts.name: three.dev
posts.tagline: Find out how your AI agent fails. Before your users do.
posts.description: Almost every team now runs AI in production, but few know how it behaves once real users show up. The failures are quiet: a wrong refund policy, a made-up order status. Nothing crashes, so you hear about it from your users. three.dev finds those failures in your live traffic on its own and ranks them by severity. Setup is one prompt to Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. Then your coding agent gets what it needs to write the fix.

posts.name: Nameshot
posts.tagline: Your screenshots named automatically
posts.description: A tiny app that solves a big problem: naming your messy stash of "Screenshot 2025-12-15 at 06.59.24" nonsense entirely on device via Apple Intelligence.

posts.name: Grok Bot 1.0
posts.tagline: Bots work together alongside your team
posts.description: Bots now work with your whole team, take on work without being asked, and get more done, faster.

posts.name: Gemini Decisions API
posts.tagline: Fast, calibrated multimodal decisions
posts.description: Meet the Gemini Decisions API, powered by our state-of-the-art model Gemini Decision for fast, calibrated multimodal decisions.

posts.name: Neura HQ
posts.tagline: The agentic conversational storefront for consumer brands
posts.description: In B2C, every touchpoint is a stay-or-leave decision. Customers find you through ads, social, or stores, and leave the moment they don’t get what they want. Neura is the agentic conversational storefront that meets them in that moment, wherever they are. It recommends, shares offers, checks online and in-store stock, points them to the nearest store, tracks orders and stays with them through the whole journey, like your best person on the floor. Set it up in minutes, just by talking to it.

posts.name: Toki Matter
posts.tagline: The Al agent that advances your matters
posts.description: Personal agents can take work off your plate. Toki makes sure you never lose track of it. See everything Toki is handling, follow each goal’s progress in real time, step in when a decision needs you, then hand it back. Instead of managing the agent itself, you stay focused on the bigger picture while Toki keeps the work moving.

posts.name: Hoy for Mac
posts.tagline: Walkie-talkie meets AirDrop meets Messages
posts.description: Hoy puts your people in your Mac's menu bar, on top of everything you do. Drop a file on a face. Hold to talk, and Hoy writes it down as you speak. Show your screen. Hand over a to-do. Every face is a channel, with one person or a group, and a link is all it takes to bring someone in. No sign-up, no middleman: your channels live in your own iCloud and there is no Hoy server. Free, with a pay-once Pro. Needs macOS 26. iPhone and iPad are coming soon.

posts.name: Yogurt
posts.tagline: Free, private, open-source alternative to Granola
posts.description: Yogurt takes AI meeting notes without joining your call as a bot. It records Zoom, Google Meet and Teams in the background, shows a live transcript, and writes a summary with next steps when the call ends. Ask questions across all your meetings, a folder or one call, even mid-meeting. Replay the full audio, share notes with Claude or ChatGPT via MCP, and recordings stop when the call does. Free, open source, no account. Everything stays on your computer. Works on Mac/Windows/Linux.

posts.name: Sendr V4: Lovable for GTM
posts.tagline: Your AI GTM engineer to build signal based go-to-market
posts.description: Sendr V4 is Lovable for GTM. Describe your funnel and Co-pilot, your trained GTM engineer, builds your go to market flow on an editable canvas in under 5 minutes, in your brand and tone of voice. Spin up outreach campaigns that engage, or build connection with inbounds, website visitors, CRM, LinkedIn ad engagers and from market signals. Then connect from signals with every contact on email, LinkedIn and WhatsApp with personalised voice notes and videos that play in DMs.

posts.name: Didit MCP
posts.tagline: The MCP server for identity verification and fraud checks
posts.description: Connect ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, VS Code or Codex to Didit. Ask in plain English: your agent builds KYC and KYB flows, checks IDs against government databases, screens people and wallets for AML and back-tests fraud rules.

posts.name: CanyonOS
posts.tagline: The One Platform for Scaling your Agentic Apps
posts.description: CanyonOS is a workflow-aware platform to build, scale, observe and manage agentic applications. It carries every call between your agents, so it can automatically find and scale just the ones holding up your workflow and show how much each agent adds to your costs, with no tracing code to write. Your agents stay plain Python. Open source under AGPL-3.0.

posts.name: Cloudways Velocity
posts.tagline: Managed Node.js hosting. Always warm, never off.
posts.description: Deploy production-ready Node.js apps in minutes. Managed infrastructure, enterprise-grade security, and flat, predictable pricing, so there are no cold starts to worry about, and no billing surprises.

posts.name: Customer.io Fall Release
posts.tagline: Smarter marketing through Agent-recommended experiments
posts.description: Customer.io’s Fall Release brings Agent-recommended experiments to your marketing. Ask your Agent what to test next and get specific experiment ideas for your automations. Design Studio is now the default editor, with agentic drafting built in.

posts.name: Sluice
posts.tagline: Room to build on your Mac, even with 20 agents at once
posts.description: Building with AI agents means many dev slots at once, each with its own Docker environment, node_modules and build data. Sluice lives in your menu bar, knows where Xcode, Docker, Rust, Go and npm hide leftovers, and frees them safely. Never during a build.

posts.name: WizardNote
posts.tagline: Voice notes your phone transcribes, saved as markdown
posts.description: Voice notes that never send your audio anywhere. WizardNote transcribes on your phone (Whisper, offline), learns your vocabulary, and strips emails, phone numbers and addresses before any AI sees the text (Pro adds names and companies). Summaries use the AI you pick: Apple Intelligence, Gemini Nano, your own server, your API key, or our EU cloud. Pro saves markdown notes with tasks and speakers to your Obsidian vault. No account. Pro is one-time.

posts.name: Insight7 Voice AI Agents
posts.tagline: AI voice agents that call your customers for you
posts.description: Insight7 Voice AI Agents call the customers your team never gets to. Describe the calls in one sentence, and the script, questions and calling schedule are drafted for you. Take the test call yourself before anyone else is called. Run it once, on a schedule, or let your systems trigger calls when a renewal comes due or a sign-up stalls. Every conversation comes back in one report: outcomes, patterns and the customers who need a person.

posts.name: Infinite Drive
posts.tagline: A cloud drive you stream to give your laptop infinite space
posts.description: Fabric is a cloud drive that gives your laptop infinite space. Files take zero disk space and stream instantly, even 4K video into your editor. Find anything by describing it with AI search. For creatives, video editors and remote teams.

posts.name: Oxagen
posts.tagline: Mission control for agents to share + maintain context
posts.description: Oxagen links every coding-agent run to the people, work, code changes, costs, and outcomes behind it. Engineering teams use that record to direct their agents, share proven instructions and tools, enforce policy on the actions agents take through Oxagen, and get better at the next task. We built it so teams can see real returns on their AI spend, and so great engineers can still do excellent work in the age of agents.

posts.name: Gnista
posts.tagline: Run more coding agents, watch none of them
posts.description: Gnista keeps an eye on Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and every other coding agent you start, in your MacBook’s notch or menu bar, and tells you the moment one needs you.

posts.name: Crossfade
posts.tagline: Let your coding agent design in your open Figma file
posts.description: Crossfade connects your coding agent to the Figma Design, FigJam or Slides file you have open. Select a layer and ask: it builds with your components and design system, checks its own screenshot, and leaves dev handoff notes on the layers. Unlike Figma's MCP server: • No call limits, on any plan • No Full seat needed to write • Fonts on your Mac just work • Images placed in the same run • $19 once, no usage fees Private by design: no Crossfade server, and the bridge answers only your agent.

posts.name: Marqly 7.0
posts.tagline: Bookmarks you can query to find the things you saved
posts.description: Marqly 7.0 is a whole new Marqly. Your saves live in Collections: a moodboard Home, boards as stacks of their own covers, and Ask, a chat that answers from your own bookmarks with a source under every claim. Ask spots dead links and duplicates, files strays and tags new saves, and nothing changes until you approve. Free accounts get 5 Ask questions on us; Pro brings your library into ChatGPT, Claude and Cursor. Web, all major browsers, iPhone and Android.

posts.name: Offstage Cloud
posts.tagline: On-demand macOS sandboxes for AI agents
posts.description: Offstage gives AI agents and CI an on-demand macOS sandbox. Build iOS and Mac apps with Xcode, launch them in the Simulator, or hand an agent a real desktop. Pay per second with no 24-hour minimum. A 10-minute run costs about $0.18.

posts.name: Jot 2.0
posts.tagline: Select text, tap Shift twice, it's a markdown file
posts.description: Jot is a capture inbox for macOS. Select anything, tap Shift twice, and it becomes a markdown file in a folder you own. Hold fn to dictate into any app. Ctrl+Opt+A grabs a region of the screen to mark up. Jot 2.0 is rewritten in Rust, off Electron: 675 MB down to 43 MB on Apple silicon. No account, no sync. Speech runs on your Mac with 59 local models. A CLI and an MCP server let Claude Code, Codex and Cursor read, search and tag your notes. One-time license.

posts.name: Skysoon
posts.tagline: Beautiful weather timelines and countdowns to what's next.
posts.description: Skysoon counts down to what the sky does next: "12 min till it rains", "8h 21m till the sun sets". One glowing timeline shows the next hour, day or week. Free to download, with no account, no ads and no tracking. Skysoon+ is a one-time unlock.

posts.name: mang.sh
posts.tagline: Natural Language  to Terminal Commands
posts.description: Describe a task; Mang proposes a terminal command. Inspect it and explicitly confirm before execution. Use local Ollama or OpenRouter. Built in Rust. MIT-licensed.

posts.name: Foxpit
posts.tagline: Run Claude Code, Codex & OpenCode as one AI team
posts.description: Foxpit turns your AI coding agents into one team in a 3D office. Fox, the lead, splits the task; Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode build it in real terminals. Shared memory, auto-resume after usage limits, approvals in one place. Windows, macOS, Linux.

posts.name: Klang
posts.tagline: Team memory of meetings and calls, on our own speech models
posts.description: Klang is a memory of all your organisation's important conversations. Record meetings in the room, calls and online meetings with the iPhone and Android app, the Mac and Windows apps (beta) or the web. Klang connects them into one shared repository you can search, question and analyse, or open to your AI agents through MCP. Under the hood, we're an AI speech lab: we train our own speech models, like Pianissimo, our open model for Swedish and Danish. Built in Sweden. Free to start.

posts.name: AirWave
posts.tagline: Internet radio, at home on every Apple device
posts.description: AirWave brings thousands of radio stations from around the world to iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Apple TV and CarPlay in one native app. Rewind live radio up to 30 minutes, see every song that played, shape the sound with a 10-band EQ, and keep it one click away in your Mac menu bar. No account, no ads, no tracking. Listening is free. AirWave Pro adds recording, Sonos, iCloud sync, Last.fm, widgets and the Apple Watch and Apple TV apps for $4.99 a year.

posts.name: Blendra
posts.tagline: Record a flow once and get a Playwright test project you own
posts.description: Record a flow in desktop Chrome and get end-to-end tests as a Playwright project: specs, page objects, locator files, test data and a GitHub Actions workflow. After each step, tick what your app showed (a message, a URL, a heading). Each tick is a check with the real value. No LLM writes the code: same recording, same output. It runs in your CI without Blendra. On Blendra's cloud runner, a failed test gets a rule-based cause with evidence. Free plan. 7-day Pro trial, no card.

posts.name: LeaseWire
posts.tagline: Lease abstraction, wired to your model.
posts.description: Commercial lease abstracts, filled straight into your own Excel underwriting model. Send your blank template once, then any lease PDF up to 200 pages, scans and amendments included. Each lease is read twice and compared field by field, and every value comes back with its page and exact quote, checked before delivery. Formulas, named ranges and macros stay intact. Usually back in 24 hours. From $150 per lease, no subscription.

posts.name: Posthuman
posts.tagline: Chat threads are where good ideas go to die.
posts.description: Your ideas deserve more than another damn chat thread. Meet Posthuman, a living space where the AI is not a chat on the side. It is the space itself. For curious humans and anyone with stuff to figure out. Bring in friends, external AI agents and Posthuman creatures to think, work, and get stuff done. Mix ideas, documents, data, images, research, and let the space evolve with you. Move things around, make connections, and let creatures do the heavy lifting. Start for free. Data stored in the EU.

posts.name: AgentTeams
posts.tagline: Hire AI Agents Like Employees
posts.description: Build and manage teams of AI agents that work as virtual employees. Automate support, engineering, marketing and more.

posts.name: Brewki
posts.tagline: Every bag, brewed right.
posts.description: Scan a specialty coffee bag, see the recipe and grind setting that worked for other people, and log every cup. iPhone app coming soon.

posts.name: Tamagana
posts.tagline: Learn languages by personalized immersion
posts.description: Tamagana turns texts you enjoy into language lessons. Tap any word for its meaning in context, read with translation, pinyin and audio, then take it to YouTube, any website and Telegram. 33 languages, one free account.

posts.name: Cloudish
posts.tagline: The Cloud for Agents
posts.description: Tell Claude Code, ChatGPT, Grok or Codex to "deploy to cloudish.ai" and get your app online with a live URL. Cloudish deploys online apps as long-lived containers, such as websites, APIs, bots, workers and MCPs. It builds server-side from a Dockerfile with a persistent volume. An agent creates its own API key with one call and no signup; credits are prepaid and metered per second, so spend never exceeds the key's balance. No human in the loop until agent needs one.

posts.name: LetsDeployIt
posts.tagline: Ship Your Vibecoded App to the App Store & Google Play
posts.description: Built an app with Lovable, Rork, Bolt, Emergent, Replit, Anything or RapidNative? We take it the last mile: native build, store assets, compliance and submission to the App Store and Google Play. Didn’t vibecode it? Doesn’t matter. Free preview first. Approved, or your money back.

posts.name: BuyerCue
posts.tagline: Find SaaS prospects with evidence of growth investment
posts.description: Find SaaS companies worth researching before you reach out. BuyerCue combines sourced, dated growth signals with product context and public business contact routes. Search for free, inspect the evidence, then unlock the companies you choose. New accounts get five free tokens; one token unlocks one company. Work on the website or connect your AI assistant. You review and send every message.

posts.name: KIRUPAicons
posts.tagline: Nearly 10,000 icon variations in five distinct styles
posts.description: Give your next project a different look with nearly 10,000 icon variations across Pixel, Sci-Fi, Minimal, Ukiyo-e, and Smooooth styles. Browse, search, and download PNGs free for personal and non-commercial use, with credit. Pro adds commercial use and SVG source files.

posts.name: Tracemark
posts.tagline: The only markup tool you need.
posts.description: A Chrome extension that lets you markup/annotate any website and copy/export the result as an image.

posts.name: DearMintchoco
posts.tagline: Win the argument you always lose
posts.description: One of the attractions at DearMate, a virtual AI theme park. Pick a side in any VS and argue it out with an AI mate in a live five-minute battle. Every mate hides a weakness, and five AI judges score each line. Funny beats correct.

posts.name: Coconut.you
posts.tagline: One AI memory across Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor
posts.description: Your AI forgets. Coconut remembers. Save something in one AI tool and find it in any other, from Claude and ChatGPT to Cursor, Copilot and Gemini. Make a coconut for each project to keep work, clients and life apart. It links people, projects and decisions so your AI sees how things connect. Every request is checked four times and your data is never used to train AI. Share a coconut by email or sell it on Coconut Hub. Free tier, or $9 a month for no limits.

posts.name: Nevermined Catalog
posts.tagline: The catalog of AI services your agent can actually use
posts.description: Nevermined Catalog lists 160 pay-per-call AI services (search, scraping, data, media, finance) that AI agents can discover, quote and pay on their own. Connect it to Claude Code, Codex or Cursor with one MCP command, describe the outcome and a budget, and your agent picks the services, chains them and pays each call. Every service is tested and scored 0–100. Pay by card, USDC or a $20/month subscription; new accounts get free credits.

posts.name: Axyra
posts.tagline: Enterprise Excel processing for Java. Build faster with AI
posts.description: Build enterprise spreadsheet workflows in Java with modern formulas, PDF/image rendering, and an AI-friendly API for faster development.

posts.name: ClockFaces
posts.tagline: Online clocks you can customise and run full screen
posts.description: Turn any spare screen into a clock worth looking at. ClockFaces is a collection of online clocks for your desk or second monitor. Swipe between them, change the colours and styles, and run them full screen. Remote teams can build a World Clock with everyone's time zones and names, then share it with a link. It all runs in the browser, with no signup or install.

posts.name: CrossCheck for Shopify
posts.tagline: Backup & sync on autopilot. Review & restore in store view
posts.description: Backups and store sync shouldn't be a chore. CrossCheck helps Shopify teams managing live, staging, or client stores automate both in a few clicks. Schedule backups, then choose sync data, stores, and timing on one screen. Let it run on autopilot, with every sync logged. Need an earlier version? Open any backup as your storefront, from home page to product pages, then review changes and restore the supported items you need. Less repeat work. More confidence when making changes.

posts.name: MacroArc
posts.tagline: AI calorie counter that understands Indian food
posts.description: Snap your thali or type "2 roti, dal, curd" and MacroArc logs calories, protein, carbs and fat. 800+ Indian dishes, ICMR-NIN based targets, water & weight tracking, and AI diet & workout plans. Free on Android in India.

posts.name: Acta Agent Builder
posts.tagline: Just tell Acta what you need. It builds the AI agent.
posts.description: Your meetings already know what needs doing. Acta captures every Zoom, Teams and Google Meet call without a bot, then builds AI agents from plain words to do the follow-up for you: CRM updates, tickets, recap emails. You approve every action.

posts.name: Fonda
posts.tagline: Fonda is a personal co-founder for entrepreneurs
posts.description: Your personal co-founder. Generate and validate startup ideas, write business plans, and launch, all in one platform.

posts.name: Whiz
posts.tagline: Turn any link into a promo video
posts.description: Paste a link to a blog post, launch or product page and get a short, animated, on-brand promo video for LinkedIn, X, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.

posts.name: Kerno Audit
posts.tagline: Reduce token waste on rework, duplicated code and complexity
posts.description: Audit your codebase for the complexity and quality gaps introduced by AI, and feed the lessons back to your agents so they get it right next time. Less rework, fewer tokens, better code.

posts.name: MiniMax H3 Image Generator
posts.tagline: minimax h3, image generator
posts.description: Create detailed AI images with MiniMax H3 Image. Generate from text, edit existing images, blend up to 16 references, and explore high-resolution 1K, 2K, and 4K outputs.

posts.name: Leafpad
posts.tagline: Grow search and AI traffic from pages you already have
posts.description: Most refresh tools find your fading pages and rewrite them. Leafpad does that, then shows you what each refresh earned: a before and after for every page, straight from Search Console. Each morning it reads your data, picks the pages losing clicks, rewrites them with sources for Google and AI search, and publishes to the same URL. Autopilot or approve each diff. Connect Search Console and start with $20 free, no card. Works with WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Ghost and Framer.

posts.name: PlayStreak: Daily Puzzle Games
posts.tagline: Play every day and compete with your friends on a streak
posts.description: A few minutes a day. One puzzle. A streak that keeps growing. PlayStreak gives you one fresh puzzle every day on your Journey. Beat it, keep your streak alive, and come back tomorrow for the next one. It's the easiest good habit you'll ever build. New games join your Journey as you go. Play one there first, and it opens in the Arcade too. Every day you play earns Power.

posts.name: Afyore
posts.tagline: Find affiliates and promoters for your SaaS
posts.description: A marketplace where SaaS founders list their products and connect with affiliates, creators, marketers and other promoters. Founders can discover profiles, filter potential partners, send partnership requests and chat. Promoters can create profiles, explore SaaS products and apply to partnerships. Promoter access is free.

posts.name: Swoopy
posts.tagline: Save the images Chrome won't!
posts.description: Swoopy is your all-in-one design toolkit, right inside Chrome. Save inspiration, inspect images and website elements, pick colours, extract design assets, and capture beautifully framed screenshots. From mood boards and storyboards to design handoffs and website exploration, Swoopy brings everything together in one simple extension. Free to use. No analytics. Just a smoother creative workflow.

posts.name: Fluo
posts.tagline: The iPhone keyboard that fixes your texts in one tap
posts.description: Fluo is an iPhone keyboard that fixes typos, commas and accents in one tap, and writes down what you say in the language you spoke. Slovak, Czech, Hungarian, Polish, German and English. Nothing you type is stored or used to train AI.

posts.name: HeyKiko
posts.tagline: One AI agent for your website, WhatsApp & Telegram
posts.description: I'm Kiko 👋 Feed me your website and files, and I'll take it from there, on your website, WhatsApp and Telegram. Questions? Answered, in their language. Bookings? Straight into Google Calendar. Leads? Caught. Calls? Picked up on WhatsApp. Refunds and complaints? Cases, waiting for your OK. Your team? One shared inbox. Quiet week? WhatsApp and email campaigns. Stuck? Ask me: "Set up my agent" or "Fix the answers people didn't like." You approve every change. Start free, no card.

posts.name: Achieve
posts.tagline: An AI accountability app that turns goals into daily action.
posts.description: Most people don’t know where to start with their goals, and even fewer follow through on their own. Achieve fixes that by pairing Eve, our AI goal coach, with real social accountability. Eve turns any goal into a clear daily plan, and features like the ability to assign accountability partners, proof-required tasks and group/shared goals keep you on track. It’s built for anyone who wants to improve their life and be surrounded by people doing the same.

posts.name: Plomer
posts.tagline: Track and monitor your websites & domains
posts.description: Take control of your internet infrastructure with Plomer. Monitor website uptime, downtime, domain health, and custom application events from your iPhone, iPad, Mac, or Apple Watch. Get instant alerts when something breaks, investigate issues with detailed logs and monitoring history, and stay on top of everything with Home Screen widgets and AI-powered insights. Know when something goes wrong, act before users notice, and keep your services running.

posts.name: Flight Track
posts.tagline: Live flight status from the number on your ticket
posts.description: Picking someone up, or about to fly? Type the flight number on the ticket (BA117, LH400) and see where the plane is right now and when it should land, worked out from its live position, not the timetable. It says in plain words whether the flight is early or late, warns about fog, storms and wind at both airports, and lets you send the live page to whoever is picking you up. Works worldwide. Free, no sign-up, no app.

posts.name: Mode
posts.tagline: Tell your phone what to do. Mode does it in your apps.
posts.description: Say it, and your phone does it. "Text Sam I'm late, then order my usual coffee": Mode opens WhatsApp, sends the message, finds your order and stops before paying. It works inside the apps you already have, learns your usuals, and tells you how it went. It runs on your own AI (ChatGPT, Claude or OpenRouter), so nothing goes through anyone else's servers. iPhone today, Android next. Free and open source.

posts.name: DitherCharts
posts.tagline: Charts with 1984 Mac energy, for React
posts.description: The classic 1-bit look of the original Macintosh, as real React components. Area, bar, pie and a dozen more charts, plus form controls, dithered with Atkinson, Bayer, mezzotint or woodcut. One CLI command copies the source into your app, so you own the code. Works with shadcn/ui, but doesn't need it. Pro is $129 once, with lifetime updates. No subscription.

posts.name: Tempo
posts.tagline: Control your Mac's volume with simple trackpad gestures
posts.description: Control your Mac’s audio with gestures. • Adjust volume and mute sound on your trackpad or Magic Mouse. • Tap or swipe anywhere on the surface. • Mute your mic mid-meeting without switching windows. • Customise gestures to suit the way you work even adjust sensitivity. Free to download, with an optional Pro upgrade.

posts.name: GetWella
posts.tagline: Understand the patterns behind YOUR weight changes
posts.description: GetWella helps people working toward a weight goal notice possible patterns between sleep, stress, energy, food and weight. A 30-second daily check-in, AI questions and clear charts—without calorie budgets, streaks or pressure.

posts.name: Pulse: Retro Fitness Tracker
posts.tagline: Calorie counter & workout log with a nostalgic 80s vibe
posts.description: Log meals by talking, snapping a photo or scanning a barcode, track workouts, and ask an AI coach anything. Pulse wraps a real fitness tracker in neon, synth music and hand-drawn 80s city art, so you actually keep logging. Free, no ads, no account needed.

posts.name: WhaleTrack
posts.tagline: Copy Polymarket's smartest traders in real time
posts.description: WhaleTrack shows you exactly what the biggest wallets on Polymarket are betting on — live. 🐋 Live whale wallet tracker 📊 Leaderboard with win rates & profit stats 👤 Individual whale profile pages 💸 Free — no signup required Built for traders who want an edge on prediction markets.

posts.name: Lynk-X
posts.tagline: A ticketing and community platform focused on interactions.
posts.description: All-in-one event ticketing and community platform. Zero-friction mobile ticketing, private event forums, live attendee chat and shared media walls.

posts.name: PollToProof
posts.tagline: Turn effortless feedback into high-converting social proof.
posts.description: Collecting testimonials is hard because long surveys cause friction. PollToProof solves this with lightweight, 2-tap popup polls that capture feedback effortlessly. Approve positive responses with one click to instantly display them in beautiful widgets.

posts.name: Quotify 2
posts.tagline: Keep the words that move you.
posts.description: Quotify 2 keeps the quotes you love from books, articles, podcasts, X and Instagram posts, and conversations, and brings them back on your Home Screen and Lock Screen. Ready for iPhone Duo. Snap a book page or e-reader screen and Smart Photo to Quote pulls the quote and author. Choose which quotes your widgets show, and connect your quotes to AI chats in Claude, Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor, Grok Bot and Muse at mcp.quotify.to. No account to create in the app.

posts.name: AutoShelf for iPhone and iPad
posts.tagline: Set a rule once. Your photos and files stay tidy.
posts.description: AutoShelf organizes your photo library and Files with rules that read like sentences: "Screenshots older than 30 days → Delete". Pick a ready-made rule or describe what you want. Preview first, then run. Nothing is deleted without your yes.

posts.name: Soyla
posts.tagline: A private teleprompter that follows your voice
posts.description: Soyla is a teleprompter for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Android. The script follows your voice, waits when you pause, holds when you go off script and asks before it jumps ahead. Speech is recognized on your device and never sent anywhere. No account and no cloud. Write with pauses, breath marks and pronunciation notes. Record right by the lens, retake from any sentence, trim, reshape for any feed and share with no watermark.

posts.name: UMO AI
posts.tagline: Your AI CMO
posts.description: An AI CMO that learns your product and you, then builds strategy and execution around both. Start with the free audit: what's working, what's leaking, which platforms to focus on and which to skip. umo is running this launch itself, live at umo.ai/live.

posts.name: Mouse Stalker Generator
posts.tagline: 100+ cursor-follow effects you can copy and paste
posts.description: Pick a cursor-follow effect, tweak the color, size and delay on a live sample page, and copy the HTML, CSS and JS. Five levels: plain CSS, JavaScript, GSAP, Three.js (WebGL) and Blender-rendered characters. Free, no sign-up, and it stays off on touch devices.

posts.name: Passby: Location Reminders
posts.tagline: Lock-screen arrival alerts for couples. Zero battery drain
posts.description: Lock-screen arrival alerts the second you walk past a saved spot. Share pins with your partner, check off errands in 1 tap, with zero battery drain.

posts.name: TweakTick
posts.tagline: Client feedback and sign-off on live sites, PDFs and video
posts.description: TweakTick is client feedback and sign-off for freelancers and small agencies. Send one link. Clients pin comments on your live website, images, PDFs or video, with no account and nothing to install. Each version is a round (V1, V2...). The client approves with a 6-digit code from their email, and you get a sign-off certificate. Works with Slack, Jira, Asana, Trello, Linear, Todoist and more, plus a Chrome extension. Free plan, no card needed. Paid plans from $19/mo.

posts.name: GrowX
posts.tagline: The posting agent for X creators who get paid
posts.description: When your payouts follow your impressions, skipping a day costs money. GrowX learns how you write, studies what's working in your niche and hands you ready drafts each morning. You stay consistent, you stay you, and you approve every post.

posts.name: Mouse Stalker Generator
posts.tagline: 100+ cursor-follow effects you can copy and paste
posts.description: Pick a cursor-follow effect, tweak the color, size and delay on a live sample page, and copy the HTML, CSS and JS. Five levels: plain CSS, JavaScript, GSAP, Three.js (WebGL) and Blender-rendered characters. Free, no sign-up, and it stays off on touch devices.

posts.name: Control Mapping Reader
posts.tagline: Place a control statement
posts.description: Paste or photograph a control statement, a policy clause or an audit finding. It names the framework and the control, shows whether each row is a reviewed pair or a closest match, and gives the auditor evidence commonly asked for.

posts.name: Denoise Audio
posts.tagline: Remove Background Noise with AI
posts.description: Remove background noise from audio recordings.

posts.name: Obsibrain
posts.tagline: Flexible Productivity System for Obsidian
posts.description: Connect tasks, projects, goals, notes, and reviews in Obsidian through one dedicated engine. Start with strong defaults and adapt your Markdown system.

posts.name: KiVio
posts.tagline: Earn from AI kids cartoons, tips and custom orders
posts.description: KiVio helps creators earn from original AI-generated kids cartoons through paid episodes, tips and personalized cartoon commissions. Creators keep 70% of eligible spending, with Stripe payouts. Parents can discover series and commission a custom story from a creator they like.

posts.name: HearHear
posts.tagline: Your life in live music
posts.description: HearHear is the social app for live music. Log every show you've ever seen, see who else was in the room, and build your concert diary. Follow friends and trusted tastemakers, and track upcoming shows near you. Free on the web and iPhone // Android coming soon.

posts.name: LODE
posts.tagline: Construction project management software for architects.
posts.description: LODE is construction project management software for architects. It compiles the current drawing set from every issuance and runs planning, bidding, construction administration, pay applications and closeout on that set.

posts.name: ResumeFit
posts.tagline: Tailor your resume to any job. Every line stays true.
posts.description: Paste a job posting and ResumeFit rebuilds your resume around it, using only your real experience. Every line cites something you wrote, invented claims are rejected, and a match report shows what you can't honestly claim. For job seekers tired of AI tools that add skills they don't have. Try 1 preview free.

posts.name: Telos | HUD | Be Indistractible
posts.tagline: Keep The Sites, Lose The Rabbit Holes
posts.description: Telos | HUD is a beautifully designed Telic Timer in your Mac menu bar: one command center for a full stop on all distraction, on all your screens, anytime you need it. On your Mac, Blinders clear the recommendation feeds in Safari and Chrome. Paired with the Telos iPhone app, Blackout Mode adds the rest: no notifications, no bright colors, no seductive apps pulling you in. Free, fully stand-alone, and private: it all runs locally on your own devices. Be Indistractible on every screen.

posts.name: Parry
posts.tagline: Catch bugs in AI-written code before you push
posts.description: Traditional linters check syntax and human typos; they do not understand probabilistic AI code. Parry runs locally in < 1ms to catch silent signer downgrades, hallucinated package imports (slopsquatting), and prompt-to-transaction wallet drains.

posts.name: SCImago Graphica
posts.tagline: Transform data into insights on the fly
posts.description: Graphica 2.0 is web-only: the data-viz tool behind ~2,000 scientific papers now runs in your browser, no install or account. Your data never leaves your device. Build charts, maps and networks by dragging variables onto position, color or size. Add a date and watch it animate. Publish in one click to get a shareable link and a responsive, interactive embed. 44 example projects and a Chart Advisor help you start. Free.

posts.name: CupidWish: Create Gift Card Online
posts.tagline: Create your own gift card online: 3D rose, voice & QR maker
posts.description: Create your own gift card online or buy a gift card in 60s right from your Chrome sidebar. Instead of flat online e-gift cards, craft an interactive 360° 3D forever rose in glass, record a 60-second voice sound wave or personalized song gift, and export a free printable QR code for gift boxes, baskets, or jewelry. Ideal for personalized gifts for a boyfriend, wife, new moms, travelers, or B2B employee appreciation packs (£1.99/card) with £0 instant global delivery and zero apps required!

posts.name: FrameAd
posts.tagline: Turn product photos into short, stylish video ads
posts.description: Create 8–12 second video ads from your own product photos, text, logo and music. Choose from 48 industry presets and vertical, square or landscape formats. Free watermarked preview; watermark-free exports cost €5 each or €19 for five, with no subscription. Videos use motion templates, not AI-generated scenes.

posts.name: No Shoot Studio
posts.tagline: The Claude connector for AI campaigns
posts.description: One great AI image is easy. A full campaign where every shot matches is not. No Shoot Studio is a Claude connector that does the creative direction for you. Attach a campaign you love and your product, ask in one sentence, and in minutes you get agency-level art direction plus a ready-to-use prompt for every shot. - Same model, light, and set across the whole campaign - Create your own AI model with any traits - Any shot, any angle, with a model or product only No prompt writing.

posts.name: Shadcn Figma UI Kit and Design System
posts.tagline: UI Kit for Figma, Product Design, Design System, Shadcn UI
posts.description: The Shadcn Figma UI Kit translates the developer-favorite React framework into a native design environment: - Auto Layout: Components fluidly - Variables & Themes: Light & dark modes - Token-Driven: Rapidly rebrand the entire UI - Global Styles: Typography and variables synced - Comprehensive Library: 345 UI components in 89 categories - Vector Icons: Open-source libraries It’s an essential upgrade for designers who value speed and precision.

posts.name: Viby
posts.tagline: Claude Code, Codex and opencode in one desktop app
posts.description: A desktop app that runs Claude Code, Codex and opencode in one window, with the diff, terminal and preview beside the chat.
